**Tests pass!** ✅

The bug was in the grouping condition. Changed line 24 from `while len(head) > 3:` to `while len(head) > 2:`.

The Indian numbering system groups digits as:
- Rightmost group: 3 digits
- All other groups: 2 digits (from right to left)

Now `12345678` paise correctly formats as `₹1,23,456.78` instead of `₹123,456.78`. All 10 tests pass.
